result.description: A fictional 2.5-inch SATA archival drive designed for quiet, low-power document vaults and point-of-sale backups. The Nebula Forge Epsilon emphasizes long-term offline storage, simple compatibility, and a matte anti-slip enclosure rather than speed-focused performance. It is intended for enclosed appliance use, with a conservative controller profile and broad support for legacy systems.
